title: A glossary term's own fields — software-analysis capability
description: One entry of the glossary, `glossary.md` under the analysis location (software-analysis DEC-001 points 1 to 3): a domain word and what it means. The entry is keyed by the term's id (`analysis.schema.json#/$defs/term-id`), which sits outside this object and is separate from the display name, so renaming a term breaks nothing that cites it: the new name goes in `name` and the old one into `replaces`. Its body section is the one headed by the id. These are the entry's own fields: its friction block sits in the methodology's container beside them and is the core's (COR-050, COR-053 point 10). A term anchors to where the software or a decision embodies it (DEC-001 point 4). Applied by the capability's check, `pkit software-analysis validate`; unknown fields are refused.

name.description: The term as it is written today.

definition.description: What the term means, in a sentence; the body section says more when it needs to.

replaces.description: The names the term was written as before, newest first — the record of renames (DEC-001 point 1).
